data.one_liner: Allows you to create a collapsible list of float buttons with animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget to display an animated collapsible list of floating action buttons. It handles opening and closing animations through a main trigger button.
use_when: You need a collapsible menu of floating action buttons on your screen.
You want to animate between a menu icon and a close icon while revealing multiple options.
avoid_when: You only need a single static FloatingActionButton.
You require complex custom transitions not supported by the package's built-in animations.
strengths: Easy to implement collapsible float action buttons.
Includes support for text labels next to individual buttons.
weaknesses: Limited customization documented beyond standard icons and colors.
Minimal documentation and usage details outside the basic example.
data.minimal_example:
final GlobalKey<AnimatedFloatingActionButtonState> fabKey = GlobalKey();

Scaffold(
    floatingActionButton: AnimatedFloatingActionButton(
        key: fabKey,
        fabButtons: <Widget>[
            add(), 
            image(),
            inbox(),
        ],
        colorStartAnimation: Colors.blue,
        colorEndAnimation: Colors.red,
        animatedIconData: AnimatedIcons.menu_close
    ),
)
